caption:
Most men are always available. Dating psychology is clear: scarcity creates obsession. This mindset changes everything.

You text her first every day. Wait by your phone. Cancel your plans when she asks. You're teaching her that nothing in your life matters but her.

She's not confused why it doesn't work. She's watching you announce that you're worthless.

Start this week: stop texting first, wait three days to respond, make plans without asking her. That's when she starts looking for you.

That's when you matter again.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
